movements.title: Sinfonia（序曲）
transpositions: unreadable crook change at the p.1→2 break

splits.note: Sinfonia begins at page 1 system 1 (Andante, 4/4, 'in Re'). 3/8 Andantino at local bar ~49 (horn tacet). New clef + crook marking at very end of page 1.
Finale section begins: 'Allegro' + alla-breve (¢) + new crook at system 1. Rehearsal letters C (~bar 22), D (~bar 39).
Rehearsal letters E (bar 1), F (~23), G (~44), H (~60). Printed digits 1-7 over repeat bars are repeat counters, not rehearsal marks.
Più mosso ~bar 25 of page 4. Ends 'VUOTA' + fermata + final double bar = end of Sinfonia; ATTO I begins on page 5 (not decoded).

status: Assistant transcription of the Sinfonia only (pages 1-4). Structure (bar count, multirests, meter/tempo changes, rehearsal letters) verified visually; dense staccato-eighth passages were decoded from detected note heads with slot-snapped offsets and carry 'uncertain' flags. No independent musician audit.
limitations: Bar numbers are page-local (counted from 1 on each page: p.1=101, p.2=61, p.3=64, p.4=64). This edition prints no bar numbers; boxed digits are rehearsal/repeat marks.
Horn part has no key signature; written pitch shown. Crook 'in Re' at bar 1; a crook change at the page 1→2 break is printed but unreadable at scan quality.
Measure-repeat bars are emitted as sim=true clones of the previous bar at mid-staff y; the underlying figure repeats the previous bar.

The dense Allegro staccato passage (p.1 systems 3-7 and most of pp.2-4) is transcribed as eighth-note figures at detected head positions; rest placement inside those bars and alternating second pitches are marked uncertain.
Rest bars are implicit (not emitted). Fermatas noted in meta.repeats per page. Cue notes (small cue-like head below staff ~p.1 bar 14) excluded.
Old-edition voicing may differ from modern scores (fanfare reads D5/Bb4 where a LilyPond reference score shows C5/A4 chord tones); transcribed literally as printed.
